statement: The function returns a result r, and r is the size of the largest connected component of the undirected graph G(nums) whose vertices are the indices 0,1,...,len(nums)-1, with an edge between distinct indices i and j iff gcd(nums[i], nums[j]) > 1. Equivalently, r = max over 0 <= i < len(nums) of |C(i)|, where C(i) is the set of indices connected to i by a path in G(nums) (including i itself).
preconditions: The slice nums satisfies the problem constraints: 1 <= len(nums) <= 20000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100000; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j].

statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r and does not fail (no panic, out-of-bounds access, or arithmetic overflow).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 1 if and only if for every pair of distinct indices i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), gcd(nums[i], nums[j]) = 1 (equivalently, no two distinct values in nums share a common factor greater than 1).
preconditions: The slice nums satisfies the problem constraints: 1 <= len(nums) <= 20000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100000; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j].

statement: If the function returns r on nums and r' on nums', then r = r'.
preconditions: Both nums and nums' satisfy the problem constraints, and nums' is a permutation of nums: len(nums') = len(nums) and there is a bijection pi on {0,...,len(nums)-1} such that nums'[k] = nums[pi(k)] for every k with 0 <= k < len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every prime p, if k_p is the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) such that p divides nums[i], then r >= k_p. Consequently, all indices whose values are divisible by the same prime p lie in one connected component of size at least k_p.
